steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete all events scheduled for this Thursday.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i calendar; ls /data/user/0 | grep -i -e simple -e calendar || true; ls /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases 2>/dev/null; ls /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases 2>/dev/null"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i calendar; ls /data/user/0 | grep -i -e simple -e calendar || true; ls /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases 2>/dev/null; ls /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases 2>/dev/null""
